caption: The drawing depicts a large, rectangular chest with a slightly domed lid, made of dark brown material that appears worn and textured. The chest is accented with evenly spaced, yellowish brass or gold-colored metal studs that outline the edges and create decorative patterns on the lid and sides. Metal handles are attached to either end of the chest, and a central lock is visible on the front. In the upper center area of the image above the chest, there is a sketch of a label or emblem featuring a design with a barrel, a saw, a box, and text that reads, "ROBERT C. MARTIN / MANUFACTURER OF / PHILADELPHIA". A green and pink floral or decorative pattern forms a background behind the label. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or detailing. The artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Trunk
